rounds.prompt: SpaghettiOs pasta only comes in one letter, O. How many cans would it take to have one pasta piece for every letter O in the entire text of the Lord of the Rings trilogy?
rounds.source: LotrProject word counts for the LOTR trilogy (481,103 words, appendices excluded); Peter Norvig, 'English Letter Frequency Counts: Mayzner Revisited' (Google Books corpus: 4.79 letters/word average, letter 'O' ≈7.64% of all letters); pasta pieces per 15.8 oz can from a hand count of Campbell's SpaghettiOs (≈1,180 pieces), reported by Nerdist and Mashed.

rounds.prompt: If converted to gold at 2026 prices, how much would the U.S. national debt weigh?
rounds.source: U.S. Treasury 'Debt to the Penny' (Aug 2026, $39.9 T) · gold spot price, Aug 2026 (~$4,430/troy oz)

rounds.prompt: How many intersections in Manhattan have traffic lights?
rounds.source: NYC Department of Transportation (2022: 13,543 signalized intersections citywide, 2,862 of them in Manhattan)
